label: Episode 15
logline: When ruthless thugs desecrate Juliana's medicinal garden and trample her late mother's herbs, a protective Alexander charges into the night to defend her.
continuity_notes: Follows Episode 14 where Alexander solemnly vowed Juliana would never be hurt again; Juliana's hands remain heavily bandaged from retrieving the emerald ring.

[00:08.50-00:11.70] JULIANA (Desperate, Alarmed): "Stop! What are you doing?!"

[00:13.00-00:15.70] THUG WITH CAP (Mocking, Smug): "We're clearing this rubbish."
[00:15.80-00:18.80] CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana, her face tight with anguish and fury as she clutches her bandaged hands against her chest.
[00:16.40-00:18.70] JULIANA (Furious, Pleading): "Those are medicinal plants!"
[00:18.80-00:22.50] CAMERA: Low-angle shot tracking down from the bald thug's grinning face to his worn leather boots on the muddy flagstones.
[00:20.00-00:22.30] BALD THUG (Callous): "They look like weeds to me."
[00:20.50-00:22.50] ACTION: The bald thug flings the bouquet into the mud and grinds his heavy boot directly onto the delicate flowers.
[00:22.50-00:26.80] CAMERA: High-angle two-shot as Juliana rushes forward and drops directly onto her knees in the cold mud before the thug.
[00:22.80-00:26.50] ACTION: Juliana frantically tries to scoop the crushed soil and torn stems back into the bed with her bandaged hands.
[00:23.20-00:26.30] JULIANA (Choked with Tears, Desperate): "Please! Those plants took months to grow!"
[00:26.80-00:31.45] CAMERA: Medium two-shot of the Tall Thug with the club and the Thug with Cap bursting into raucous laughter under the full moon.
[00:27.50-00:31.20] TALL THUG (Contemptuous, Derisive): "Months? You actually spend your days growing this filth?"
